description: Credential write-back test vectors shared by the Python engine (tests/test_fix_writeback_identity.py) and the Go engine (router/cli_sandbox_private_home_writeback_fix_test.go). 'host' is the host credential at launch (null: absent), 'sandbox' the copy the sandboxed provider left behind. expect.refuse lists the refusal codes (nothing is written, one warning); otherwise expect.host is the host document afterwards (unchanged: nothing written; equal to 'sandbox': the sandbox bytes are written verbatim) and expect.ignored the protected fields added or removed in the sandbox copy (non-empty: one warning). Optional minted_keys lists keys the provider CLI mints itself in that file (muse's api_key, minted only inside an object in muse's OAuth login shape; a saved or pasted key stays protected); both engines pass them to the merge, and the Python engine runs such cases through the muse profile.
notation: {"$raw": text} is a file given byte for byte; other documents are written as compact JSON. A string "$jwt:<claims JSON>" stands for the unsigned JWT base64url('{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}') + '.' + base64url(<claims JSON>) + '.c2ln'.
